content:
The Power Fist is a mechanical glove mounted with a hydraulic piston powered ram. The devices were originally used as pre-War hardware for demolition crews.[1] When punching, the pistons push the ram forward, smashing into the enemy. Sometimes enough power is transferred to the target to knock them down. Some Power Fists are powered by Small Energy Cells, including those manufactured by BeatCo.[2]

Although it cannot be used in conjunction with power armor, the fist is a potent close quarters combat weapon for just about any build relying on Unarmed damage to survive. It requires level 30 to first equip and is then available in two more grades at level 40 and 50.

Face Breaker - A unique variant of the powerfist obtained as a quest reward from A Knight's Penance. It has a unique dark yellow skin and a white skull drawing inscribed.

↑The Art of Fallout 4 p. 234: "Chapter 5 WEAPONS It's not all about the guns, of course. The melee selection was expanded as well, with a eye toward entertaining builds designed to deliver massive (and painful) physical damage. Some of these weapons were initially intended for purposes other than inflicting harm. The power fist and super sledge are prewar hardware originally used by construction crews for demolition. But it certainly didn't take much imagination to find alternative uses for them."

↑Items.txt: "A "Big Frigger" power fist from BeatCo. Considered by many to be the ultimate weapon to use in unarmed combat. Others are just scared. Powered by small energy cells."

↑Hunter: "You might be a prized fighter, but I doubt you'll be able to punch a Radstag to death." (Hunter's dialogue)
